dedupe_keys.name: capacites d accueil du reseau en corse

description: Capacités d'accueil du réseau en Corse is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by EDF Corse. Capacité d'accueil par poste source (en MW) pour le raccordement aux réseaux de transport (HTB) et de distribution (HTA) des installations de production d'électricité. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Environment & Energy. Its keywords are Réseau, Capacité, S3REnR, Production, S2REnR. The portal shows 34 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
